headline: Cirebon deputy mayor inspects flood-prone Perumnas Gunung Lawu drainage
summary: Wakil Wali Kota Cirebon meninjau lokasi banjir di kawasan Perumnas Gunung Lawu, Kecamatan Harjamukti, dan meminta saluran air segera dikeruk karena drainase dinilai menjadi penyebab utama genangan.
summary_id: Wakil Wali Kota Cirebon meninjau lokasi banjir di kawasan Perumnas Gunung Lawu, Kecamatan Harjamukti, dan meminta saluran air segera dikeruk karena drainase dinilai menjadi penyebab utama genangan.
summary_en: Cirebon's deputy mayor inspected flooding at Perumnas Gunung Lawu in Harjamukti district and asked for drainage channels to be dredged promptly, citing blocked drainage as the main cause of the inundation.
